title: 第11章  老狗，你们有没有胆闯？
content_zh:
段天仇和秦北二人对视一眼，皆皱起眉头。
“陆烬有这般能耐，恐怕会影响到五门三宗的选拔！”
“血月圣地每次从五门三宗选拔的弟子不超过十人，这家伙若是出战，不知道哪个宗门天才会被淘汰…”
“不过，在此之前，他或许会跟柳如烟有一场恶战。”
“走，抓个万剑宗弟子，问问到底怎么回事。”
陆烬出了万剑宗后，一路直奔雷火山。
经过之前的战斗后，他体内第六颗灵珠逐渐凝聚成形，而一旦他修行冲击境界，势必会再次引来雷劫。
他不想太过招摇，毕竟除了万剑宗外，整个青州还分布着大大小小不少势力，高手如云的世界，他不想节外生枝。
而之所以会选择雷火山，除了那里有他曾经掩藏的宝物外，雷火山长年雷云密布的环境，也能掩人耳目。
一路飞掠数百里，陆烬灵力满满，无半点疲倦。
飞掠过程中，他将一千灵石打入葬天棺，而葬天棺的灵力反哺，让他在战斗中的消耗很快全部弥补。
两个时辰后，他的气息再次恢复巅峰！
“雷火山…三年未曾来过，这里还是一如既往的荒凉。”
陆烬站在一片山崖上，脚下是一望无际的黑色岩石，天空是终年不散的翻滚乌云，云层中时不时有闪电划过，偶尔降临山林间，化为雷火，焚烧大地…
而在如此雷火环境下，山林间依旧生长着大片大片的植被，不过这里的植被清一色全部呈现黑红之色，甚至一些焦黑的雷击木上，也有火苗般的枝叶在迎风招展。
此地常年荒无人烟，偶尔来到这里的人，也是修炼了火焰属性功法的修士前来历练。
“老狗，你们追了我一路，不过，前方号称雷渊之地，雷电如蛇，我倒要看看你们有没有胆子闯！”
罗鹫等人一路跟踪，陆烬早就察觉到了。
不过，他并没打算将其斩杀。
他们死了，恐怕会招引更大的麻烦，在对方不会对自己构成威胁的情况下，倒不如先这么吊着。

而且，那前方闪电最密集之地的雷渊他曾来过，熟悉地形，经过灵珠劫的他并不惧怕雷电之威。
身形一闪，直接钻入雷渊之内，身形消失。
“嗯？他居然真敢钻进去！”
后方不远处，看见陆烬这般举动，罗鹫等人忍不住磨牙。
“罗长老，此子之前经历三天雷劫都不曾损伤一丝一毫，此处雷电恐怕也无法伤害到他，倒是我等并不曾渡过金丹劫…”
几人都是灵珠境，还未经历过雷劫洗礼，眼神中难免浮现紧张之色。
而金丹一品的罗鹫倒是经历过金丹雷劫，可此刻的他看到雷渊上空盘踞的雷蛇后，眼神同样不安。
“此处雷霆之力远强于一品金丹雷劫！哪怕是本长老都不敢贸然擅闯，不如就在此地等待，暗设埋伏，一旦他出现，就地格杀！”
罗鹫此话一出，其他几人面色皆是一变。
他哪来的自信说出这种话的？
这么快就忘了之前差点被人家弄死的事了？
“呵呵，有姬峰主给的毒剑十绝阵，我等未必没有杀他的资格！”
“毒剑十绝阵？没想到啊没想到！”
“有如此阵法，我等的确可以暗中埋伏，杀他一个措手不及！”
“行动！”
陆烬自然不知罗鹫几人暗施伎俩，他钻入雷渊深处，立刻找到一处隐蔽之所，拿出楚天雄以及段天仇几人给的纳戒。
其中还有从王凡，牛长老等人手上获得的战利品。
“这些家伙个个都是大款啊！”
清点了一下纳戒里的物品，除了大量灵石外，还有一些兵器，秦北段天仇二人送的纳戒中甚至还有紫阳门和狂刀门所特有的功法战技！
而这些纳戒中的灵石加在一起，居然足足五万！

小小的激动了一下，他看向了宗主楚天雄给他的纳戒。
“嗯？这是…万剑朝宗诀？”
吸引视线的，是一部功法！
那功法乃灵气凝聚，悬浮半空，道道符文闪烁着古朴的气息。
“传闻万剑宗开派祖师留下来的至强剑法，而唯一有资格修炼的，就是历代掌门！”
陆烬没想到，楚天雄会将这部剑诀送给自己！
想到之前楚天雄跟自己说的那些话，虽然他并没有要求自己做什么，但是，似乎所有的目的都变得明确起来…
“宗主大义凌然，可我陆烬自有我自己的事。”
“师尊之仇，不得不报！”
“柳如烟杨巅峰害我之仇，不得不报！”
思忖片刻，陆烬又扫视了纳戒中其它物品，除了一些疗伤丹药外，这宗主居然给他留了足足三万灵石！
比师尊玄云子留给他的还要多！
“这倒是…”
陆烬心情颇有些复杂。
无功不受禄，可如今承了如此重情，他也是颇为感慨。
“不管怎样，先把实力提升起来，不然，一切都是空话！”
“不过，这名单是什么？”
视线里，出现灵光闪烁的一排名字，陆烬皱眉思忖，却没想出个所以然。
按他推测，宗主给他的东西，定是有意安排。
可这些人名，的确让他猜不透。

就在这时，一道雷霆降临而下，整片雷渊都颤了几颤。
“哈哈哈，来吧，让雷霆来的更猛烈些吧！”
他不再拖沓，直接原地盘膝而坐。
一千灵石直接打入葬天棺内，顿时一股狂暴气息从周身涌荡而起，体内第六颗灵珠开始疯狂凝聚。
与此同时。
虚空之上雷云凝聚，原本散乱的雷云此时疯狂朝着他头顶那片虚空汇聚过来，雷蛇狂舞，逐渐变成粗大的雷龙，惶惶天威压境，宛若灭世！
不知过去多久，那凝聚的雷龙开始向着下方大地降落。
一道又一道，璀璨夺目，狂暴骇人…
“罗长老，你快看！”
“难道是那家伙又在渡劫？”
“太恐怖了！这雷霆力量，就算三品金丹境都无法承受！”
“灵珠境难道也能召唤雷劫？匪夷所思！”
“废话少说！毒剑十绝阵一旦成了，那剧毒的力量，足以将他灭杀！”
content_en:
Duan Tianchou and Qin Bei looked at each other and frowned.
"With Lu Jin's ability, I'm afraid it will affect the selection of the five sects and three sects!"
"Blood Moon Holy Land selects no more than ten disciples from five sects and three sects at a time. If this guy goes into battle, I don't know which sect genius will be eliminated..."
"However, before that, he may have a fierce battle with Liu Ruyan."
"Let's go, arrest a disciple of Wanjian Sect and ask what's going on."
After Lu Jin left Wanjian Sect, he went straight to Thunder Mountain.
After the previous battle, the sixth spirit bead in his body gradually condensed and took shape. Once he reaches the realm of cultivation, it will inevitably cause thunder disaster again.
He didn't want to be too ostentatious. After all, in addition to the Wanjian Sect, there were many large and small forces scattered throughout Qingzhou, and there were many masters in the world. He didn't want to add to the problem.
The reason why he chose Leishan Mountain was that, in addition to the treasures he had hidden there, the thundercloud environment of Leishan Mountain all year round could also deceive people.
After flying hundreds of miles along the way, Lu Jin was full of spiritual power and not tired at all.
During the flyby, he drove a thousand spiritual stones into the Sky Burial Coffin, and the spiritual energy from the Sky Burial Coffin fed back, allowing him to quickly make up for all the losses he had suffered in the battle.
Two hours later, his aura returned to its peak again!
"Thunder Mountain... I haven't been here for three years, and this place is still as desolate as ever."
Lu Jin stood on a cliff, with endless black rocks at his feet. The sky was filled with rolling dark clouds that never dispersed all year round. Lightning flashed through the clouds from time to time. Occasionally, it descended into the mountains and forests, turning into thunder and fire, burning the earth...
In such a thunder and fire environment, there are still large tracts of vegetation growing in the mountain forests, but the vegetation here is all black and red in color, and even some charred lightning-struck trees have flame-like branches and leaves waving in the wind.
This place has been deserted all year round, and the people who come here occasionally are monks who have practiced fire-attribute techniques to practice.
"Old dog, you have chased me all the way, but the land ahead is called the Thunder Abyss, and the thunder and lightning are like snakes. I want to see if you have the courage to break through!"
Luo Jiu and others followed them all the way, and Lu Jin had already noticed it.
However, he had no intention of killing it.
If they die, they will probably cause more trouble. As long as the other party does not pose a threat to themselves, it is better to hang them like this for now.
Moreover, he had been to the Thunder Abyss, the place with the densest lightning in front of him, and was familiar with the terrain. After going through the Lingzhu Tribulation, he was not afraid of the power of thunder and lightning.
The figure flashed, dived directly into the thunder abyss, and disappeared.
"Huh? He actually dared to get in!"
Not far behind, Luo Jiu and others couldn't help grinding their teeth when they saw Lu Jin's behavior.
"Elder Luo, this son has experienced three days of lightning tribulations without any damage. I am afraid that the thunder and lightning here will not be able to harm him. However, we have never survived the golden elixir tribulation..."
Several of them were in the Lingzhu realm and had not experienced the baptism of thunder tribulation, so nervousness was inevitable in their eyes.
Luo Jiu, who is a first-grade Jindan, has experienced the Jindan Thunder Tribulation, but at this moment, when he saw the thunder snake entrenched above Leiyuan, his eyes were equally uneasy.
"The power of thunder here is far stronger than the first-grade Golden Core Thunder Tribulation! Even I, the elder, dare not rush in rashly. It is better to wait here, set up an ambush, and kill him on the spot once he appears!"
As soon as Luo Jiu said this, the expressions of the other people changed.
Where did he get the confidence to say such a thing?
Have you forgotten so quickly that you were almost killed by someone before?
"Haha, with the Ten Jue Formation of Poison Swords given by Peak Master Ji, we may not be qualified to kill him!"
"The Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation? I didn't expect it! I didn't expect it!"
"With such a formation, we can indeed ambush him secretly and catch him off guard!"
"Action!"
Naturally, Lu Jin didn't know what Luo Jiu and the others were doing secretly. He went into the depths of the thunder abyss, immediately found a hiding place, and took out the ring given by Chu Tianxiong and Duan Tianchou.
Among them are Wang Fan, Elder Niu and others.The loot in hand.
"All of these guys are rich!"
After counting the items in the Najie, in addition to a large number of spiritual stones, there are also some weapons. The Najie given by Qinbei Duan Tianchou even contains the unique martial arts and combat skills of Ziyang Sect and Kuangdao Sect!
The total number of spiritual stones in these Najies is actually fifty thousand!
A little excited, he looked at the ring given to him by the sect leader Chu Tianxiong.
"Huh? This is... the Wan Jian Chao Zongjue?"
What catches the eye is a technique!
The technique is a condensation of spiritual energy, suspended in mid-air, and the runes are shining with a simple atmosphere.
"It is rumored that the founder of Wanjian Sect has the most powerful swordsmanship left behind, and the only ones qualified to practice it are the past heads!"
Lu Jin didn't expect that Chu Tianxiong would give this sword art to him!
Thinking of what Chu Tianxiong said to him before, although he didn't ask him to do anything, it seemed that all his purposes became clear...
"The sect master is righteous, but I, Lu Jin, have my own affairs."
"Master's revenge must be avenged!"
"Liu Ruyan and Yang Dingfeng harmed me, and I have to avenge it!"
After thinking for a moment, Lu Jin glanced at the other items in the Najie. In addition to some healing pills, the sect leader actually left him a total of thirty thousand spiritual stones!
Even more than Master Xuan Yunzi left to him!
"That's true..."
Lu Jin's mood was quite complicated.
No reward for no merit, but now that he has received such great affection, he is quite emotional.
"No matter what, improve your strength first, otherwise, everything will be empty talk!"
"But what is this list?"
A row of names flashed in his sight. Lu Jin frowned and thought, but he couldn't figure out the reason.
According to his speculation, the things given to him by the sect master must have been deliberately arranged.
But these names really made him unable to guess.
At this moment, a bolt of thunder descended, causing the entire Lei Yuan to tremble.
"Hahaha, come on, let the thunder come more violently!"
He stopped procrastinating and sat down cross-legged on the spot.
Thousands of spirit stones were directly driven into the burial coffin. Suddenly a violent aura surged from the whole body, and the sixth spirit bead in the body began to condense crazily.
at the same time.
The thunderclouds condensed in the void. The originally scattered thunderclouds gathered crazily towards the void above his head. The thunder snake danced wildly and gradually turned into a thick thunder dragon. It was as if the world was destroyed by the overwhelming power of the sky!
I don't know how much time passed, but the condensed thunder dragon began to land towards the ground below.
One after another, dazzling, violent and terrifying...
"Elder Luo, look!"
"Is that guy trying to survive the tribulation again?"
"It's too terrifying! Even the third-grade golden elixir realm cannot withstand the power of this thunder!"
"Can the Lingzhu realm also summon thunder tribulation? It's unbelievable!"
"Stop talking nonsense! Once the Poison Sword Ten Jue Formation is completed, the poisonous power will be enough to kill him!"
